quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its security portfolio covers perimeter, application, data, cryptographic, industrial-control, endpoint, cloud and AI security products plus professional security services, organised around three strategic directions it calls 'AI in SEC, AI for SEC, SEC for AI'. At its Navigator Summit in May it built a full-stack security protection system for AI agents spanning compute, models and applications and launched three core products: an AI firewall built for AI scenarios (which it calls industry-leading), an AI security gateway combining identity governance, dynamic authorisation and content / data security, and an Agentic SOC autonomous security operations platform.
